title: An exact rational separator excludes every certificate in the named heat class
statement: For F=u^2+v^2+3w^2+16q^2+4q(u-v),an exact acoustic Gram gives rank-one margin2/17. The rational dual has ell(E_I F)=-4049717/6250000 and ell(E_I q^2)=80001/25000000>0,annihilates all closed quadratic two-form corrections and is nonnegative on every bilinear SOS. Thus every gamma>=0 is excluded;finite symmetry averaging transfers every constant-SPD spatial-diffusion certificate to this excluded identity class.
